fields.Name: Collaboration: Grant Run
fields.Description: A granted view, query or dashboard was run (or refused) through Collaboration's grant operations (B17, D29): one row per run, with the grant, the space, the caller, the bound names (never their values) and the agent run when an agent made it. Stands in for MJ's resource access log (A2) until it ships.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Note Promoted
fields.Description: A Team note was promoted to Shared (B21, the plan's call 15): one row per promotion, with the note, the space and who promoted it. The note's text moves; its comments and conversation stay with the team.
